text:
tara: hey folks, quick question on first-day observability: I can open the Datadog dashboards but Grafana dashboards intermittently 403 after SSO. i accepted the invite and re-logged but still hit a cookie/auth wall sometimes. anyone seen this?

nina: hey tara, welcome! :wave: yep we had a funky SSO propagation issue last month. usually a full browser restart or incognito fixes it. also check that you're in the `obs-team` group on https://access.redwood.com/groups/obs-team — if not, request access there.

ops-bot: Access ticket created: id=AT-9921, resource=Grafana:Dashboards/Observability, requester=tara. Status=pending. Use `access status AT-9921` for updates.

tara: thx. i tried incognito and that worked. curious if anyone can point me to the canonical "service traces" panel — the link in the dev docs returns 404.

kai: the traces panel moved into a new folder. go to Dashboards -> Observability -> Service Telemetry -> "Service Traces (waterfall)". we've renamed some panels to include (v3). docs will be updated but not all quickstarts got changed.

tara: got it, thanks. two more quick Qs: 1) can I create low-level monitors in Datadog for my feature env? 2) for sharing Grafana visuals in PRs, should i use iframe or snapshot?

nina: 1) monitor creation is restricted to SRE+owners; for feature env alerts open a monitoring change request (link in infra handbook) or ask SRE via the oncall tag. for low-severity checks they'll usually create it if it's useful. 2) always prefer Snapshot -> External link for PRs (no auth) or export image. iframe embeds require internal auth and will 403 for external reviewers.

kai: small tip for dashboards: if you need a static image for docs, Panel -> Share -> Direct link rendered image is handy. for interactive panels when everyone is internal, use the panel link.

tara: nice. also saw a Sentry project but the runbook says sensitive issues might be scrubbed; how do we view full reports for debugging?

nina: Sentry is configured to strip PII by default for prod projects. if you need full payloads for a debugging session, open a temporary access request and tag `security` and the owning team. they can grant time-limited view or provide a sanitized dump. never paste PII into Slack.

ops-bot: Access update: Grafana viewer role granted to tara.

tara: confirmed I can view the traces panel now. thanks! one tiny UX request: keyboard shortcuts for Grafana? any favorites to navigate faster?

kai: press `g` then `d` for dashboards, `g` then `p` for panels, `/` to quick search dashboards, `t` to open time range picker, and `s` to share panel. also the bottom-left help menu has the full list.

tara: awesome — saves time. last thing: if i take a snapshot of a panel and it's stale, what's the cache refresh cadence? we debugged an old metric earlier.

nina: snapshots are point-in-time. live panels pull from the backend. some metrics may have a 30s-60s ingestion delay depending on the source. for realtime checks use Datadog APM or the raw trace viewer. if you think metric ingestion is delayed, ping `#eng-infra` with sample trace IDs.

devex-bot: Welcome to Redwood! If you need help with access, run `open-access-request` or ping #devex.

tara: huge help, thanks everyone. i'll add a short note to the onboarding doc about the SSO cookie quirk and the snapshot vs iframe pitfall. happy to pair if anyone wants to standardize the links in the quickstart. :tada:
